name: A2A Agent Card
description: Fetch a remote agent's public Agent Card via the .well-known/agent-card.json endpoint

url.description: Base URL of the remote A2A agent (e.g. https://agent.example.com)

bearerSecret.description: Optional caller-owned SecretStore reference (for example s/PARTNER_A2A_TOKEN) whose value is sent as a standard HTTP Bearer credential. Mutually exclusive with bearerToken.

bearerToken.description: Optional literal bearer token for this request. Mutually exclusive with bearerSecret; redacted from Job records.
